description: The dashboard summary in one call: totals, coupling density and band, the largest regions with health scores, the most connected nodes (with map kind), and recent commit activity. Use when you want a single orienting snapshot rather than four separate calls. Region scores are null where there is no evidence — that means 'not measured', not 'zero'.

zoom.description: Map zoom for graph-derived fields. Defaults to feature; echoed on the response.

name: repository_overview
title: Repository overview
